thread:
Maeve: spot check — the tenant UI is showing 'v2-ready' for `globex` but our router metrics still show ~40% v1 handshakes. anyone know why?
Rohan: I saw that too. console reads from the feature-flag store; router uses client handshake header. flags got flipped in admin yesterday for the opt-in.
Sam: That explains it. But we should avoid a UI that implies billing moved. Customers are confused.
Ally: Proposed quick fix: change copy to 'console display: v2' vs 'traffic: v1'. two separate pills. less binary.
Maeve: +1. Also need to capture both values in logs so analysts can join them easily. Right now telemetry only captures client_version.
Rohan: Can we add two fields: display_version (from flag) and observed_version (from handshake)? both low-cardinality strings.
Sam: Yes but telemetry schema change must be reviewed. keep field names short: disp_ver, obs_ver.
Ally: Security note: observed_version sometimes includes SDK build metadata with a user agent. strip extras. only keep semver or major.
Maeve: Good point. Normalize to major.minor or just major. e.g., 1 -> v1, 2 -> v2.
ops-bot: Reminder: Telemetry schema PRs require a migration window. See #analytics for details.
Rohan: Also propose a 'display-only' rollout mode: console shows v2 for admins but billing/tagging stays on v1. Useful for marketing previews and staged UX tests.
Sam: If display-only exists we must ensure billing and quota APIs always read billed_version from the router's billing tag, not from console flags. avoid double-accounting.
Ally: Implementation sketch: router emits billing_tag header `X-Billed-Version: v1|v2` that downstream billing reads. Console continues to use feature flag for display_version.
Maeve: For joinability, let's emit a short fingerprint: `route_sig = sha1(header_ver||route_id||first8(tok_hash))` but use an HMAC key rotated monthly. store only prefix 12 chars to keep logs small.
Rohan: I prefer `HMAC-SHA256` truncated to 12 hex chars. ops team can provide key via KMS. Document in security-runbook.
Sam: Sampling plan: initially collect route_sig for 0.5% of global requests, escalate to 5% for tenants with active rollouts. Avoid spiky billing.
Ally: Need an alert: if observed_version != disp_ver for >20% of requests for a tenant over 15m, create a P2 pager to #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: PLAT-1402 (observed/display mismatch).
Maeve: UX note: in tenant console show small info icon with tooltip: "Display version is an admin setting and may not reflect live client traffic". Legal OK? I'll loop them in.
Rohan: Also update API docs: /v1 clients keep header `X-Redwood-Client: v1` or we infer from Accept. add sample curl: ```curl -H "X-Redwood-Client: v2" https://api.redwood.ai/generate```
Sam: One more: analytics needs a derived metric `tenant_mismatch_pct` so product can see how many customers are in this in-between state.
Ally: I'll add to the dashboard: per-tenant bar with disp_ver vs obs_ver and mismatch pct. small visual.
Maeve: Action list: 1) Telemetry schema PR (Sam) 2) Router header `X-Billed-Version` + billing read fix (Rohan) 3) route_sig HMAC helper + key rotation doc (Ally + eng-security) 4) Console UI change + tooltip + legal check (Maeve) 5) Sampling + alert (ops)
Rohan: I'll open RFC for display-only rollout policy with examples and migration notes.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: router-config v2026.03.22-03 -> canary.
Maeve: Let's try to get minimal UI copy done before the canary so we don't confuse support.
Sam: I'll draft the telemetry PR and include KQL examples for analysts.
Ally: Ping me for reviews on the HMAC helper function.
Maeve: thanks team. closing loop here, follow-ups in PLAT-1401/1402.
